prompt:
A wide establishing vista of Rio de Janeiro in a storybook gaslamp-fantasy steampunk world — environment key art for a game world map, with no people.

The place: a storybook gaslamp-fantasy Rio de Janeiro on a warm golden afternoon: the great rounded granite peak rising from the turquoise bay, little polished brass-and-wood gondolas gliding on fine cables from the lower peak to its summit, great brass cable wheels turning in the stations; a white two-tiered arched aqueduct striding across the old quarter with a little open tram crossing on top; steep lanes of pastel houses with wrought-iron balconies climbing green rainforest hills; a curving beach promenade paved in black-and-white stone waves, striped bathing tents on the white sand and brass-trimmed paddle-steamers puffing clean white steam across the bay; airships with striped balloons drifting past the peaks and gas lamps glowing along the shore.

Composition: a sweeping view from a high vantage point at a three-quarter angle, layered depth — framing elements in the near foreground, the city spread across the middle ground, mountains and sky far behind. The whole city reads at a glance as one memorable skyline. Keep the lower quarter of the picture calm and slightly darker (water, terrace or treetops without detail clutter) so interface cards can sit over it.

Style: painterly environment key art matching Korean MMORPG character artwork — 2D painting with visible brushwork, layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, a few crisp accents; rich atmospheric perspective and luminous light.

No people, no characters, no animals in focus; no text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermark; no frame or border.

Avoid: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, hologram, digital display, touchscreen, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, soot, grime, rust, coal smoke, sweat stains, photographic texture.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.
